title: Cho2017 within-subject jaw-clench donor bank: feasibility and cohort definition
frozen_before: any harm statistic, any decoder accuracy, and any look at subjects 6-52
why_this_file_exists: The Stage T1c gate failed, 2/5 on a ratio criterion in the 8-32 Hz band.
That criterion was mis-specified: the 8-32 Hz band contains both alpha, which
falls during any task, and muscle activity, which rises. The reported ratio is
the net of two opposing effects rather than a measurement of muscle. Subject 3
demonstrates the failure directly: ratio 0.99 in 8-32 Hz while carrying 1.42e5
of 40-100 Hz power against 1.8e4-2.8e4 in the other four blocks, and the highest
This file replaces the criterion. It does not edit the old one. The failed gate
is reported as measured, with its numbers, alongside the deviation.

pilot_exclusion.reason: already inspected during T1b and T1c; the 3.0 threshold below was chosen while looking at them
pilot_exclusion.handling: processed and reported separately, excluded from every confirmatory count

cohort.locked_opening_condition: not opened until the development analysis has been run once and written

block_identification.basis: measured, not taken from the publication's prose ordering
block_identification.evidence: 5/5 subjects agree by max HF/LF ratio; spectral flatness 0.695-0.813 versus 0.24-0.64 elsewhere; HF maximum over temporal sites; temporal/frontopolar HF ratio 2.0-4.4
block_identification.note: This order differs from the order in which the publication lists the six non-task recordings. Slots 1 and 2 are separated by a single lateral-antisymmetry statistic and that separation is weak in subject 4 (r = -0.067). Only slot 3 is claimed with confidence, and only slot 3 is used.

constants.note: a NEW entry, not an overwrite of the PhysioMotion entry; the two banks are never mixed inside one number
constants.epoch_reason: Cho2017 provides about 3 s of imagery per trial; the 4 s epoch of the BNCI branch does not exist in this dataset
constants.reference: CAR over exactly the 19 COMMON19 channels
constants.band_power_method: Welch PSD, nperseg 512 at native rate, mains bins +/- 2 Hz dropped at 60/120/180; never a time-domain band-pass on a short block

primary_criterion.name: muscle index MI_d
primary_criterion.definition: MI_d = P(40-100 Hz, mains bins dropped) of a donor window / P(40-100 Hz) of the same subject's resting block, averaged over COMMON19
primary_criterion.rationale: 40-100 Hz carries no sensorimotor rhythm, so the alpha-suppression confound that broke the previous criterion cannot enter
primary_criterion.feasibility_PASS: at least 20 accepted subjects out of the 47 confirmatory subjects
primary_criterion.threshold_provenance: 3.0 was chosen after seeing the five pilot subjects; that is why the pilot is excluded from the count

donor_windows.rule: all three non-overlapping 3 s windows inside the 10 s jaw block
donor_windows.selection: by MI_d only; no selection on any outcome quantity
donor_windows.rest_arm_donors: 3 s windows tiled across the resting block, same pipeline

arms_to_be_built_now_and_analysed_later.A_within: donor = subject i's own jaw windows, host = subject i's MI trials
arms_to_be_built_now_and_analysed_later.B_between: donor = jaw windows drawn from subjects other than i, host = subject i
arms_to_be_built_now_and_analysed_later.C_rest: donor = subject i's own resting windows, host = subject i
arms_to_be_built_now_and_analysed_later.donor_count_matching: arm B is subsampled to the same number of donors per host as arm A, redrawn 25 times and averaged, so that the A-versus-B comparison is not a comparison of counting noise
arms_to_be_built_now_and_analysed_later.validity_gate_before_any_other_reading: artifact-only decoding accuracy in arm A must stay below 0.55; above that the donor carries the subject's own decodable background and arm A is void, exactly as the synthetic branch was voided

bad_trials.bad_trial_idx_mi: excluded from the clean pool AND stored separately; these are trials in which real muscle activity coincided with the task, and their natural SNR distribution is what limitation 8 currently lacks

published_regardless_of_outcome: the full MI_d distribution per subject
the 8-32 Hz jaw-versus-rest ratio per subject, including the failed T1c gate
the number of subjects rejected by QC and why
the deviation statement covering the replaced criterion
what_this_file_does_not_claim: that jaw clenching is chewing; it is the same muscle group and a different behaviour, and it is reported as a new artifact class
that Cho2017 achieves simultaneity; jaw and imagery are still separate blocks, so this closes the same-subject/same-session axis and not the simultaneous-with-task axis
